pca_lean_scratch.note: P2: PCA fit skips the dead +mu restore pass (2 n*d words) and sizes the two n*d alias buffers to the IDENTICAL route's scratch (split-K partials / v1 workspace / 1). Waste removal; same words.

tsvd_one_upload.note: T1: TruncatedSVD.fit calls tsvd_fit_explained (new export, device + host twin): one H2D copy of X shared by the Gram and the explained-variance tail instead of two. OFF arm runs the two host functions in order inside the same export.

rsvd_idn_direct_in.note: R1: randomized_svd uploads M from the caller's buffer (x_decomp_dev_upload into a pooled device matrix, w4 flag bit 2) on IDENTICAL too, instead of _M.from_input's host array copy. Waste removal; same words. CONFIRMED 2026-10-09 (post-merge A/B, nv n0607 -> n0622, amd a1066 -> a1082): the _OFF arm is slower, randomized-svd istella NV 3.06x / AMD 2.15x, taxi NV 1.39x / AMD 1.12x, same digests.

gemm_tn_centered.note: P3: past the split-K Gram width, the covariance Gram centers at its tile load on the v1 SPLIT plan's arithmetic (same leaf partition, per-cell chain, partial and fold launch), X read-only; falls back to shift + gemm_tn when the shipped dispatch would not run a split plan. Same staged words as shift_columns_kernel, so no bit should move; the ID check settles it.

pca_device_truncate.note: P5: spectrum order (spectrum_rank_desc, ties to the lower index) and top-k component gather on the device; only k x n components + 2 n words cross. Bits move only on tied eigenvalues (the old exchange sort's tie order); the host column reads the same switch: build the host binding with it too.

colvar_fused.note: T2: _column_variance's second pass folds the centered squares in registers in xty_tiled's tile order and chain, X read-only (-2 read/write passes over X and over X V^T). Same words into the same fold.

classical:pca.route: fit: PCA.fit -> pca_fit_binding -> pca_fit_host [pca_lean_scratch] -> compute_covariance (column_mean_launch; split-K centered Gram | [gemm_tn_centered] | shift + gemm_tn_identical_v1) -> eig_and_truncate (_eig_rr_device [pca_rr_one_block]; host tail | [pca_device_truncate])
classical:pca.note: gemm_tn_centered reads x_alias2, which pca_lean_scratch sizes; it only acts past the split-K width (d > 128). pca_rr_one_block and pca_device_truncate are independent of the Gram switches.

more:tsvd.route: fit: TruncatedSVD.fit -> tsvd_fit_explained [tsvd_one_upload] (tsvd_fit_device: gemm_tn + eig_and_truncate [pca_rr_one_block, pca_device_truncate]; _tsvd_explained_tail: gemm_nt + 2x _column_variance [colvar_fused])
more:tsvd.note: colvar_fused leaves X read-only, which the merged tail does not need but the OFF arm of tsvd_one_upload does not depend on either; cross them once.

expanded:randomized-svd.note: Copy-only; R2 (rsvd_tsqr_ortho, classical-structural) is the existing control for the dominant orth stage and is not repeated here.
